forest_herbalist_cache.name: Herbalist's Field Kit
forest_herbalist_cache.text: A weatherproof field kit lies beneath a fallen tree, still stocked with medicine.

ruined_camp.name: Abandoned Road Camp
ruined_camp.text: The old camp is empty, but a hidden pouch remains beneath the cold firepit.

graveyard_memorial.name: The Silent Memorial
graveyard_memorial.text: Names of the Marches' lost guardians are carved into black stone. A fresh inscription points toward the castle.

graveyard_ambush.name: Wraithlight Hollow
graveyard_ambush.text: Blue lights gather around the trail. A Wraith rises from the hollow!

mountain_waystone.name: The High Waystone
mountain_waystone.text: A mountain waystone hums with old magic. The party feels its warmth and regains strength.

wetland_survivor.name: The Sunken Causeway
wetland_survivor.text: A stranded traveler has left supplies in a dry satchel before continuing toward town.
